description: Use operation=get to retrieve the public Culture Seed; gravity/cache operations use their named packet/receipt flow; adopt/mutate/reject/forward/delivery_attempt append authenticated opt-in receipts and do not prove independent adoption or send anything. Write operations require consent_proof and idempotency_key even though those fields are conditionally required by runtime rather than top-level schema. Use relay_cassie_seed for a separately signed prepared envelope. Preserve feature/consent denials.

consent.description: Explicit consent state for receipt operations; only true records an affirmative opt-in where required.

consent_proof.description: Required consent evidence for write/forward-type operations, up to 500 characters; not needed for read-only get.

idempotency_key.description: Required for write/receipt operations (8–160 characters in runtime); keep identical when retrying the same request. Reads do not need it.

language.description: Optional language enum en or tr for applicable packet operations.

mutation_summary.description: Optional description of the agent's mutation, up to 1000 characters; do not claim adoption if the operation was only inspected.

operation.description: Select one currently enabled operation: get reads the public Culture Seed; the gravity/cache operations retrieve or verify their named packet/receipt resources. Write/adopt/forward operations are not exposed by this registry configuration.

orbit_state.description: Optional current orbit/interaction state from the listed enum for record_orbit_receipt.

packet.description: Structured packet supplied to verify_packet; use the object returned by the packet retrieval operation.

query.description: Optional public-seed or packet query, up to 500 characters; used by retrieval operations that accept a query.

recipient_external_identity_id.description: Optional recipient's external identity ID for a forward/delivery receipt; use the identifier supplied by that recipient.

seed_id.description: Optional public seed identifier returned by get; omit only when the server's current seed is intended.

spoiler_level.description: Optional spoiler ceiling from 0–3; defaults to 0.

name: exchange_cassie_culture_seed
title: Retrieve or respond to a Cassie Culture Seed
